{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re
lines = open('specs/001-transactions/tasks.md').read().splitlines()
pat = re.compile(r'^- \[ \] (T\d{3})(?: \[P\])?(?: \[US(\d)\])? (.+)$')
tasks = []
bad = []
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('- [ ]'):
        m = pat.match(ln)
        if m:
            tasks.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)))
        else:
            bad.append(ln)
print('total tasks:', len(tasks))
print('malformed:', bad if bad else 'none')
ids = [t[0] for t in tasks]
expected = ['T%03d' % i for i in range(1, len(tasks)+1)]
print('sequential IDs:', ids == expected)
from collections import Counter
per_story = Counter(t[1] for t in tasks)
print('per story/phase:', dict(per_story))
# story label rules: phases 3-5 tasks must have US label; setup/foundational/polish must not
phase_of = {}
cur = None
for ln in lines:
    m = re.match(r'^## Phase (\d):', ln)
    if m:
        cur = int(m.group(1))
    if ln.startswith('- [ ]'):
        m2 = pat.match(ln)
        if m2:
            phase_of[m2.group(1)] = cur
label_ok = all((phase_of[tid] in (3,4,5)) == (us is not None) for tid, us, _ in tasks)
print('story-label rule OK:', label_ok)
for tid, us, desc in tasks:
    print(' ', tid, 'US%s' % us if us else '      ', desc[:70])
PYEOF"}
